caption: The drawing depicts a single object centered within a rectangular border, which appears to be a necklace or torque, rendered in shades of yellow and brown. The main object is U-shaped with a smooth, rounded outer edge and a slightly angular upper portion; it is decorated with a pattern of repeating triangular notches or incisions along its outer perimeter. There are fine details around the notched areas that suggest texture or engraved ornamentation. Two small circular features are present on both arms of the U near the top, possibly representing attachment points. To the upper left, there is a small, simple line drawing of an oval shape labeled "1/2 nat. S." with dimensions indicated. In the upper right, another small line drawing shows a side view of the main object, focusing on the profile and curvature. The background is a plain beige color, with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Baby's Earring
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
